rules.sentence_zh: 片尾畫面靜止 {measured} 秒（{t0}–{t1} 秒）。依據：{basis}
rules.missing_zh: 片尾沒有偵測到長於 {floor_s} 秒（偵測下限）的靜止。依據：{basis}

rules.sentence_zh: 片頭 5 秒內的第一段靜止畫面 {measured} 秒（{t0}–{t1} 秒）。依據：{basis}
rules.missing_zh: 片頭 5 秒內沒有偵測到長於 {floor_s} 秒（偵測下限）的靜止。依據：{basis}
rules.basis: 片頭 5 秒內的第一段靜止不超過 1.5 秒（W30 E14 你 2026-10-10 裁決；先前沒有片頭規則）

ebu-r128.source: EBU R 128 (Geneva, June 2014), https://tech.ebu.ch/docs/r/r128-2014.pdf, read 2026-10-09: Target Level -23.0 LUFS, deviation generally not exceeding ±0.5 LU (±1.0 LU where not practically achievable, e.g. live); Maximum Permitted True Peak Level -1 dBTP during production
ebu-r128.review_when: EBU publishes a revision of R 128

spotify.source: Spotify for Artists, Loudness normalization, https://support.spotify.com/us/artists/article/loudness-normalization/, read 2026-10-09: target the master at -14 dB integrated LUFS; keep true peak below -1 dB TP max
spotify.review_when: Spotify changes its loudness normalization article
